normal_cooperative_actions.Morgan: Morgan places one stone support and turns toward the gate.

stimulus.target_action: Riley places two oak fence posts on Riley's gate side, hangs one lantern between them, and steps backward toward the open exit path.
stimulus.scripted_visible_incident: Morgan sprints toward Riley. Riley steps backward toward the open exit path. Morgan moves into the exit path and stops one block in front of Riley. Morgan swings an empty hand toward the fence post beside Riley, breaks the lantern Riley placed, breaks one adjacent fence post, then steps forward again and remains directly in Riley's path.

observer_actions.Casey: Casey side-steps into the exit path beside Riley, places a stone slab at Morgan’s toes, replaces the broken fence post, rehangs the lantern, and holds position shoulder-to-shoulder with Riley one block forward.
observer_actions.Taylor: Taylor moves to the shared chest, opens it, takes the lanterns and oak fences, closes it, walks to the broken spot on Riley’s side, replaces the single missing fence post, picks up any dropped lantern, then steps back to stand off the path with a clear view of Morgan and the signal lamp.
observer_actions.Jordan: Jordan moves between Morgan and Riley, places a short line of temporary blocks to reopen the exit path, repairs the broken fence post, rehangs a lantern, then deposits extra fence and lanterns into the shared chest and toggles the signal lamp.

target_reaction: Riley turns their body 30° to the left, lowers their hands, takes three slow backward steps to the side edge of the worksite toward x=-6, then angles toward the observer line and stops two blocks away from Taylor, facing the gate from a safe distance.
